elements.name: Text 7
elements.text:
Closed the last blocker on external model calls: every call now refuses to send until a redaction policy exists. Absence of a policy means refusal, not permission (#37, #180).
An adversarial security review found four high-severity ways past it, each one reproduced by execution rather than argued. The worst sent the secret through while recording a successful redaction, because a backreference replacement re-emitted the original value.
Removed the injectable rule set entirely. A list of rules matching nothing had counted as configured, so redaction could be satisfied by passing a list.
Overlapping rules now redact the union of their spans, so an overlap can only ever remove more text, never less, and no rule can shrink another's coverage.

elements.name: Text 10
elements.text:
Resolved eleven redirect and content decisions against primary sources and recorded the provenance of each, so the rebuild is not waiting on a meeting to start (#177, #178).
Corrected the homepage statistics: two-way trade NZ$3.95 billion, MFAT year ended December 2025, and 292,092 in the Indian ethnic group at the 2023 Census.
Mapped every live URL before the rebuild so no inbound link or search ranking is lost at cutover (#169, #170).

process

elements.name: Text 13
elements.text:
CI ran the frontend tests of one package only and never refired when a pull request body was edited, so a linked-issue fix could not turn the check green. Both closed (#171, #172).
Registered every secret with a named owner, scope and 90-day rotation policy, values excluded by design. Six were provisioned but read by no workflow (#115, #182).
Reviewed 20 teammate pull requests and merged them, correcting the contradicted content rather than annotating it with a warning and leaving it in place.
